verdict.rationale: dlt ships a first-party LanceDB destination, described as a multimodal lakehouse for AI that stores data objects and supports similarity search, so synced data can land in a vector store for agent retrieval. The rest of the story is thinly evidenced: there is a single vector-store destination and no documentation of embedding, chunking or LLM-ready output formats. missing for 10: other vector store destinations, documented embedding/chunking into LLM-ready formats, details of the retrieval workflow for agents, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, pipelines load into vector stores and LLM-ready formats so my agents can retrieve what was synced

citations.quote: LanceDB is a multimodal lakehouse for AI... This destination helps you load data into LanceDB from dlt resources.
It allows you to store data objects and perform similarity searches over them.
